architectural_units.name: Security Service
architectural_units.description: Functions as a reverse proxy and load balancer, managing HTTP and HTTPS request routing.

architectural_units.name: Traefik
architectural_units.description: Modern reverse proxy and load balancer designed to manage incoming and outgoing HTTP and HTTPS traffic in container-based applications.

architectural_units.name: System Service
architectural_units.description: Serves the web application and interacts with the database and external services.

architectural_units.name: Next.js
architectural_units.description: Framework for building web applications used to implement the System Service.

architectural_units.name: Data Service
architectural_units.description: Provides the relational database for storing application data.

architectural_units.name: PostgreSQL
architectural_units.description: Relational database management system used for the Data Service.

architectural_units.name: ORM
architectural_units.description: Technique for converting data between object-oriented programming types and relational database persistence.

architectural_units.name: Prisma
architectural_units.description: ORM tool used to simplify database access and management.

architectural_units.name: Authentication Service
architectural_units.description: External service used for user authentication.

architectural_units.name: Google
architectural_units.description: External provider used for user authentication.

architectural_units.name: Cloud Storage Service
architectural_units.description: External service for storing and retrieving files.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: Cloud storage service used for storing and retrieving files.

architectural_units.name: Payment Processing Service
architectural_units.description: External service for handling payments and subscriptions.

architectural_units.name: Stripe
architectural_units.description: External service integrated for handling payments and subscriptions.

architectural_units.name: Analytics Service
architectural_units.description: External service for tracking and analyzing site traffic.

architectural_units.name: Google Analytics
architectural_units.description: External service implemented to track and analyze site traffic.

architectural_units.name: Error Monitoring Service
architectural_units.description: External service for tracking and managing application errors.

architectural_units.name: Sentry
architectural_units.description: External service used to track and manage errors in the application.

architectural_units.name: Email Service
architectural_units.description: External service for creating, sending, and scheduling emails.

architectural_units.name: Brevo
architectural_units.description: External service connected to for creating, sending, and scheduling emails.

architectural_units.name: Docker
architectural_units.description: Platform used to manage the execution of containers for the services.

architectural_units.name: React
architectural_units.description: JavaScript library used to build user interfaces.

architectural_units.name: TypeScript
architectural_units.description: Strongly typed programming language used for the System Service.
Security Service (Traefik) manages HTTP and HTTPS request routing towards the System Service (Next.js).
System Service (Next.js) communicates with the Data Service (PostgreSQL) using Prisma as ORM.
System Service (Next.js) interacts with Google for user authentication.
System Service (Next.js) interacts with Amazon S3 for storing and retrieving files.
System Service (Next.js) interacts with Stripe to handle payments and subscriptions.
System Service (Next.js) interacts with Google Analytics to track and analyze site traffic.
System Service (Next.js) interacts with Sentry to track and manage errors in the application.
System Service (Next.js) connects to Brevo for creating, sending, and scheduling emails.

architectural_units.name: HTTP/HTTPS
architectural_units.description: Security Service (Traefik) manages HTTP and HTTPS request routing towards the System Service (Next.js).

patterns.name: Microservices
patterns.description: The architecture implemented for the development of the Revivack project system is a microservices-based architecture.

patterns.name: Component-Based
patterns.description: The Component-Based pattern focuses on building the user interface by creating independent and reusable components.

patterns.name: Observer Pattern
patterns.description: The Observer pattern establishes a one-to-many relationship between objects, where a subject maintains a list of observers that are notified of state changes.

patterns.name: Singleton Pattern
patterns.description: The Singleton pattern ensures that a class has only one instance and provides a global access point to that instance.
